blocks.x: From the Planning Commission (1950, an executive resolution) and the NDC to **NITI Aayog (2015)** with no allocative power.
blocks.in: Five Year Plans ended after the 12th (2017); **plan/non-plan distinction abolished** the same year; three-year action agenda and vision documents replaced them.
blocks.gl: Indicative planning in France; imperative planning in the USSR.
blocks.w: India moved from **plan-led allocation to budget-led allocation** with indicative strategy.

blocks.x: Transfers to states once governed by a formula, now largely through the Finance Commission and CSS.
blocks.th: **Gadgil formula (1969)** and **Gadgil-Mukherjee (1991)** — population 60%, per capita income 25%, fiscal performance 7.5%, special problems 7.5%.
blocks.in: Rendered obsolete when the Planning Commission went; the FC and CSS now carry transfers.
blocks.gl: Equalisation grants in Canada and Australia.
blocks.w: The formula's demise shifted power to the **Finance Commission and the Union budget**.

blocks.x: Union-designed, state-implemented programmes with shared funding.
blocks.in: Rationalised to **75 CSS** in Core of the Core, Core and Optional; sharing typically **60:40**, and **90:10** for NE and Himalayan states; **Single Nodal Agency** with just-in-time release.
blocks.w: States argue CSS **ties untied money and distorts state priorities** — the sharpest live dispute after cesses.

blocks.x: Plans built upward from the village and district rather than downward from the state.
blocks.th: **Article 243ZD** District Planning Committee; **Balwant Rai Mehta** and **G.V.K. Rao** on the district as the planning unit.
blocks.in: **GPDP** and the People's Plan Campaign 'Sabki Yojana Sabka Vikas'; Kerala's 1996 campaign devolving 35-40% of plan outlay.
blocks.w: DPCs exist in most states but rarely **consolidate anything the state budget honours**.

blocks.x: Priorities are revealed by allocation, not by statements of intent.
blocks.in: Capex ₹12.22 lakh crore in FY27 with effective capex 4.4% of GDP; health 1.84% of GDP against the 2.5% target; education ~4.6% against 6%.
blocks.w: Quote the **gap between target and allocation** — it is the strongest evaluative line.

blocks.x: Plans need concurrent monitoring and independent evaluation to be more than intentions.
blocks.in: Aspirational Districts' real-time dashboards and delta ranking; PRAGATI; third-party evaluations of CSS before continuation.
blocks.w: Continuation of a scheme should turn on **evaluation, not inertia**.
